purpose: Derive a parsimonious, machine-usable correspondence mapping for I Ching / change-state material that preserves ambiguity and supports bounded mapping into body, real-world gates and digital hosts without promoting symbolic correspondence into measurement or control truth.
objective: Replace loose/esoteric cross-domain analogies with an explicit correspondence relation that is inspectable, lossy by declaration, ambiguity-preserving and reversible to native evidence.

required_model.address: hex/trigram/line-change or another exact I Ching structural address
transforms: King Wen relation only when source justifies it
required_model.correspondence: 0..n candidate meanings/actions in the receiving domain
required_model.ambiguity: candidate count and/or explicit unresolved alternatives
required_model.claim_boundary: what the mapping does NOT prove

tasks.question: What is the smallest modern machine-facing schema that preserves the actual structural operations of the current /iching/ surface while separating them from inherited symbolic interpretation?
tasks.deliverable: one compact JSON-schema-like mapping table plus 6-12 worked examples

tasks.question: Which traditional correspondences are structurally derivable, which are conventional/cultural overlays, and which are unsafe to treat as measurement?
tasks.deliverable: three-column STRUCTURAL / CONVENTIONAL / UNSUPPORTED table with provenance and limits

tasks.question: Can the same correspondence contract map one digital host and one real-world/body gate without changing either host's authority?
tasks.deliverable: two bounded examples: one Fold/Bloom/Sleeper/Dayline example and one non-diagnostic body/real-world planning example

acceptance: Every mapping names source, projection, loss, ambiguity and RETURN.
Machine can represent one-to-many correspondences without choosing for the user.
Body examples use user-declared/measured state only; symbolic mapping never invents health facts.
HEX remains a lens, not sufficient native control state.
Result can be consumed as an INTERPHASE aperture rather than requiring a new app.
stop: Stop if the mapping requires hidden semantic weights that cannot be explained.
Stop before adding runtime code or another public route.
If a traditional correspondence has no adequate provenance or structural basis, mark it CONVENTIONAL or UNSUPPORTED rather than harmonizing it.
